title: Milroy cipher telegrams (Cox 3 Dec 1862, Bascom 4 Dec 1861): found solved by Richard Bean, 2026

steps.what: cryptiana's unsolved list (fetched 2026-09-14) marks the item Solved by Richard Bean with Claude Opus 5, 2026.
Spot check on Milroy's copy: 'imboden by to forward' is column 6 rows 1-4 downward and 'what is if' column 1 rows 3-1 upward, consistent with Bean's grid.
Blind word-bigram search over all 6-column routes (route.py) did not converge: unreliable transcription, nulls and code words. Not pursued.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): the lesson-plan transcription of Cox's telegram copied from route.py to texts/cox1862_transcription.txt; the decryption is Richard Bean's, linked on cryptiana (modern work, not copied); the Bascom telegram of 4 Dec 1861 is not a document of this profile

outcome.method_basis: Richard Bean's solution (cryptiana, 2026) was known before the attempt and spot-checked on two routes of Milroy's copy; the project's own blind route search did not converge.
outcome.notes: Solved by Bean 2026; only spot-checked here, nothing added; key state is Bean's. README lists it among entries solved by others and not counted in the results.

credits.note: solution of the Milroy telegrams (Stager cipher No. 7, with Claude Opus 5), spot-checked here; nothing added

texts.label: Cox to Milroy, 3 Dec 1862 (Richard Bean's decipherment, 2026)
texts.summary: A Union telegram in Stager Cipher No. 7 (a word route transposition with indicator words) from Cox to General Milroy: 'If your information as to Imboden is confirmed, let me know by what route you shall try to reach him, also how far forward in the Moorefield Road'. Deciphered by Richard Bean with Claude Opus 5 in 2026; the full decipherment is on Tomokiyo's cryptiana page.
